title: Microsite Content Brief
description: Schema a wiki/clients/<slug>/microsites/<slug>.md content brief should conform to before it is built into a page via templates/pages or templates/sites. See AGENTS.md §8.

client_slug.description: Matches the client's slug under wiki/clients/.

target_keyword.description: Primary keyword this microsite is built to rank for.

business_info.description: NAP and business details to populate templates/sections (contact block, schema markup).

pages.description: One entry per page this microsite needs, mapped to a templates/pages skeleton.

template.description: Path under templates/pages/ or templates/sites/ this page is built from.

sections.description: Ordered list of templates/sections/ this page composes, with the copy for each.

sources.description: wiki/ pages this brief was derived from (keywords.md, competitors/*.md, recommendations.md).
